race.comment: TASK AT HAND (8) finished runner-up last start, beaten a nose, in a far better performance at this track over 1780m. Primary contender in a similar race. HEIRTOTHECROWN (5) finished fifth two runs ago then broke and finished a distant last over 1780m at this track at the latest appearance. Won't find this any harder and he can bounce back. AURELIE (6) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish third at this track over 1780m. the debutant SOMEWHEREOUTTHERE (4) should be monitored in the betting.
